title: Odisha’s first geotube sea wall to check erosion comes up in Pentha
verified_claim_paraphrase: The contemporary report describes the initial 675-metre design and says its revision reduced the planned wall to 505 metres. It reports construction had been suspended and then resumed after design corrections. This corroborates the length figures independently of the later CAG report.
claim_limits: This is a contemporary newspaper report, not the CAG audit or an archived copy of it.
It does not connect the revision to Cyclone Phailin; retain CAG attribution for that causal account.
It does not establish the audit’s specific delay findings or incomplete-work assessment.
Do not substitute its project costs or reported construction timeline for the audit’s differently dated figures.
It describes planned construction in April 2015, not current wall length, structural condition or engineering effectiveness.
